components.name: BookController
responsibilities: Expose REST endpoints under /api/v1/books for registering, updating, retrieving and deleting books
Bind and validate inbound Java Record DTOs (CreateBookRequest, UpdateBookTitleRequest) with @Valid
Delegate all business logic to BookService without containing domain or persistence logic
Return ResponseEntity with proper HTTP status codes (201, 200, 204) and BookResponse payloads

components.name: BookService
responsibilities: Implement book registration use case, enforcing unique ISBN constraint (AC-1.2)
Implement title update use case keyed by ISBN, validating non-empty title (AC-2.1, AC-2.3)
Implement book lookup by ISBN returning BookResponse (AC-3.1)
Implement book deletion by ISBN (AC-4.1)
Throw DuplicateIsbnException and BookNotFoundException for negative scenarios
Map Book entities to and from Java Record DTOs

components.name: BookRepository
responsibilities: Provide JpaRepository<Book, UUID> persistence operations for the books table
Declare findByIsbn(String isbn) : Optional<Book>
Declare existsByIsbn(String isbn) : boolean for duplicate ISBN detection
Declare deleteByIsbn(String isbn) : long for catalog removal

components.name: Book
responsibilities: Domain aggregate root mapped to the books table
Hold id (UUID primary key), isbn, title and author with validation constraints @NotNull, @NotBlank
Represent the library catalog entry persisted and retrieved by the repository layer

components.name: CreateBookRequest
responsibilities: Immutable inbound payload for book registration
Carry @NotBlank isbn, @NotBlank title and @NotBlank author fields

components.name: UpdateBookTitleRequest
responsibilities: Immutable inbound payload for book title update
Carry @NotBlank title field validated before service invocation

components.name: BookResponse
responsibilities: Immutable outbound representation of a Book
Expose id, isbn, title and author to API clients

components.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
responsibilities: Translate BookNotFoundException into HTTP 404 with an error payload (AC-2.2, AC-3.2, AC-4.2)
Translate DuplicateIsbnException into HTTP 400 with duplicate ISBN message (AC-1.2)
Translate MethodArgumentNotValidException into HTTP 400 with field-level validation messages (AC-1.3, AC-2.3)
Provide a single, consistent error response contract across the service

components.name: BookNotFoundException
responsibilities: Signal that no book exists for the supplied ISBN
Carry the offending ISBN for error message construction

components.name: DuplicateIsbnException
responsibilities: Signal that a book with the supplied ISBN already exists
Carry the duplicate ISBN for error message construction

endpoints.summary: Register a new book with a unique ISBN, title and author
Update the title of an existing book identified by its ISBN
Delete a book from the library catalog by ISBN

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Audit Library API
  description: Auto-generated API contracts for audit-library conforming to Spring
    Boot 3 / Java 21 Records.
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
- url: http://localhost:8080
  description: Local server
paths:
  /api/v1/books:
    post:
      summary: Register a new book with a unique ISBN, title and author
      operationId: post_api_v1_books
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookResponse'
        '400':
          description: Error response 400
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateBookRequest'
  /api/v1/books/{isbn}:
    put:
      summary: Update the title of an existing book identified by its ISBN
      operationId: put_api_v1_books__isbn
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookResponse'
        '400':
          description: Error response 400
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/UpdateBookTitleRequest'
    get:
      summary: Retrieve book details by ISBN
      operationId: get_api_v1_books__isbn
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successful operation
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/BookResponse'
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
    delete:
      summary: Delete a book from the library catalog by ISBN
      operationId: delete_api_v1_books__isbn
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Successful operation
        '404':
          description: Error response 404
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails'
components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetails:
      type: object
      required:
      - timestamp
      - status
      - message
      properties:
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        status:
          type: integer
        message:
          type: string
        details:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
    BookResponse:
      type: object
      description: Immutable Java Record response for Book
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        isbn: &id001
          type: string
        title: &id002
          type: string
        author: &id003
          type: string
    CreateBookRequest:
      type: object
      description: Immutable Java Record request with Jakarta validation for Book
      required:
      - isbn
      - title
      - author
      properties:
        isbn: *id001
        title: *id002
        author: *id003

userStories.intent: register a new book with a unique ISBN, title, and author
userStories.benefit: maintain an accurate and up-to-date library catalog

scenarios.given: a librarian with valid book details (ISBN, title, author)
scenarios.when: they submit a request to register the book
scenarios.then: the system creates the book and returns HTTP 201 with the created book details

scenarios.given: a book with an ISBN that already exists in the system
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to register it
scenarios.then: the system rejects the request and returns HTTP 400 with an error message indicating duplicate ISBN

scenarios.given: a book with an empty title
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to register it
scenarios.then: the system rejects the request and returns HTTP 400 with an error message indicating title cannot be empty

userStories.intent: update the title of an existing book identified by its ISBN
userStories.benefit: correct or modify book information as needed

scenarios.given: a book exists with a known ISBN
scenarios.when: the librarian updates the title with a valid new title
scenarios.then: the system updates the title and returns HTTP 200 with the updated book details

scenarios.given: a book does not exist for a given ISBN
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to update its title
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 404 with an error message indicating the book was not found

scenarios.given: a book exists with a known ISBN
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to update the title to an empty string
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 400 with an error message indicating title cannot be empty

userStories.intent: retrieve book details by its ISBN
userStories.benefit: find information about a specific book in the library

scenarios.given: a book exists with a specific ISBN
scenarios.when: the patron requests the book by ISBN
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 200 with the book details

scenarios.given: no book exists with a specific ISBN
scenarios.when: the patron requests the book by ISBN
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 404 with an error message indicating the book was not found

userStories.intent: delete a book from the library catalog by its ISBN
userStories.benefit: remove outdated or lost books from the system

scenarios.given: a book exists with a specific ISBN
scenarios.when: the librarian deletes the book by ISBN
scenarios.then: the system removes the book and returns HTTP 204 No Content

scenarios.given: no book exists with a specific ISBN
scenarios.when: the librarian attempts to delete it
scenarios.then: the system returns HTTP 404 with an error message indicating the book was not found
